text: Program OverviewThe degree considers the relationships between tourism and management systems, mechanisms for regional and community planning and development, and the role of tourism as a social, cultural and economic phenomenon. Students will be confident and competent to make contribution to tourism and tourism planning, and sensitive to the needs of tourism, tourism destination communities, industry and the visitor.Fee26,000 RMB per yearDuration4 yearsDegree AwardedQualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Tourism Management by Shandong University
